tagline: Answer typed questions about a state
description:
Span-01 Lite is the free, lighter tier of Span-01, a behavior scoring model from Respan. It returns, for each plain-language behavior you define, the probability that the behavior is present...

Only accepts noul questions whose instructions and criteria are plain strings. Scores a conversation span: connect a conversation that ends with an assistant reply (converted automatically), or a string.

inputs.name: state
inputs.type: string or object or array or array of objects or array of strings or conversation or message
inputs.description: The conversation span to score: a conversation ending with an assistant reply (converted to { input, output } automatically), a single assistant message, or plain text. Other structured data is sent as JSON text.

inputs.name: questions
inputs.description: Map of question id -> typed question. Each question has a type ("noul" = yes/no probability, "choice" = pick one option, "score" = rate on ordered levels), instructions, and criteria (noul: optional { true, false }; choice: { option: description|null }; score: ordered array of 2-10 level descriptions). Answers come back under the same ids.

outputs.name: answers
outputs.description: Typed answer per question id. noul: { type, noul }; choice: { type, choice, probabilities, confidence }; score: { type, score, legend, probabilities, confidence }

outputs.name: values
outputs.description: Shortcut map of question id -> primary value (noul probability, chosen option, or score)

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The versioned model id that answered (aliases resolve to a specific version)
